current_benchmark.mapping_claim: No road-time conversion is supported by the current c1-c89 trajectory.

leakage_prohibitions: future load or observation not available at forecast issue time

recommended_step.definition: Close a block at a calibrated exposure increment, a maximum calendar duration, a material environment shift, an inspection, or maintenance, whichever occurs first.
recommended_step.fallback_without_wim: Use inspection-to-inspection epochs and do not claim sub-inspection field timing.
recommended_step.name: calibrated_equivalent_load_block_with_caps
recommended_step.why_not_fixed_calendar_only: Traffic and environmental exposure can differ materially between equal calendar intervals.
recommended_step.why_not_fixed_esal_only: Ageing, moisture, temperature, and maintenance are not represented by traffic count alone.

load_distribution.units: declared force or strain proxy bins

selection_rule.choose: The simplest block definition passing all tests without future failure information.
selection_rule.development_only: Compare candidate block definitions on physically diverse training trajectories.
tests: h1-h3 field/support gate at identical observed origins
stability when each block is subdivided
no hidden maintenance or observation event inside a block

time_axes.axle_cycle: Observed axle or axle-group passage from WIM/traffic records.
time_axes.calendar_time: UTC or local civil time used for ageing, weather, drainage, and inspection scheduling.
time_axes.equivalent_load_index: Cumulative calibrated traffic-damage exposure; ESAL is one possible convention, not a universal state clock.
time_axes.fem_fatigue_cycle: Numerical state update under one declared benchmark loading protocol; simulation-only index.
time_axes.inspection_epoch: Time at which image, FWD, strain, or other observations update the latent state.
time_axes.load_block: Forecast integration interval containing a declared axle spectrum and environment history.
